title.zh: Michael Saylor’s STRC has been off parity for five months
title.en: Michael Saylor’s STRC has been off parity for five months

current_state.zh: Strategy's variable-rate perpetual stock STRC has traded below its $100 par since May 15 despite repeated buybacks, with the company facing fresh headwinds after MSCI deemed MSTR a non-operating business and removed it from its Global Investable Market Indexes.
